issues.title: Going Commando PAL: main menu never drawn (func_V1_002CA070 is a no-C stub), plus more HUD aliases to map
issues.author: JuanjoAvila
issues.body:
Summary
On the Going Commando PAL disc (SCES_516.07), the main menu is never drawn. The intro movies play and can be skipped with Start, the level-0 backdrop renders and the game keeps running, but no menu or HUD appears. You cannot reach "Load game" or "New game".
Right after the movies are skipped, the log shows:
[info] movie at sector 568474: Start pressed (pad 0xfff7)
[info] movie at sector 568474: skipped
[warning] func_V1_002CA070 has no C in the port yet; it does nothing

func_002CA070…

issues.title: Suggestion: Support for HRTF and surround sound
issues.author: StarPepe
issues.body: It would be great to have support for HRTF for surround on headphones, as well as support for 4.0, 5.1 and 7.1 surround audio.
